notablePrerequisites: Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {W}.
When the Spirit dies, Twilight Drover triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat.
